author: The Big T
text_post: Mystery at Saddle Ranch in Hollywood So I went to Saddle Ranch in Hollywood the other night. I did pretty well but thats not the point of this post. I didn't know until a day later when someone told me that mystery used to go to Saddle Ranch and wrote about it.  In thinking back to the bar I can totally understand why mystery's outrageous peacocking (in my opinion at least) would work at a bar like that.  Yes I know its not what you wear but how you wear it. But I can still see how he would look less out of place at a bar like that then say downtown Fullerton, where I usually go out.  I realized when I was there that the jeans and T-shirt I was wearing were downright boring compared to the amount of style that was present in that place. I could have gone more outrageous than I would be comfortable with and still not have looked over the top. Does anyone peacock differently depending on the style of venue they are going to that night? -Big T

author: sdnightfly
text_post: 3 words - cheap valet parking. It's a casual but country vibe. It's a good place to go for a drink and it has a comfortable feel to it. I thought there were more tourist than local, people staying with relatives that live in the area, and they're usually the ones looking for something fun to do.  I don't remember anyone wearing cowboy hats, but I can't see it hurt having one on while you're in there.
